name: owned_creature_damage_total/attack_count observe the Honored Ancestor's own melee swings
contract: Regression for the gameplay harness itself: spell_damage_count/total only accept a player's own GUID, pet
GUID or a currently-present owned creature (GetOwnedCreature, which needs the creature alive at query time
and only recognizes GetOwnerGUID ownership). A player-summoned guardian, totem or temporary pet that deals
melee swing damage was unobservable through that family (melee swings are excluded by design) and through
pet_melee_* only as melee alone, never combined with any spell damage the same summon might also deal.
owned_creature_damage_total, owned_creature_damage_count and owned_creature_attack_count fill that gap: they
sum the actor's already-recorded melee outcomes and spell damage events for creatures of a given entry,
purely from historical combat-log packets the actor's session received, without resolving a live creature
pointer. Honored Ancestor 51265 (AscensionBarbarian::Ancestor, ascension_summon_level_damage) is a Barbarian
guardian pet (a Pet-type object: its own GUID encodes a pet number, not its creature entry, unlike a plain
temporary summon), which lets this scenario cross-check the new metric's live-entry resolution and melee
aggregation against the established pet_melee_swings/pet_melee_damage metrics: both families must report the
same swing count and total damage for the same fight (a miss contributes to the swing count but not to the
landed-hit count, so owned_creature_damage_count is bounded by, not equal to, the swing count).
